items.title: Dream Squad
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Dream Squad has arrived! Join the crew and change out your old look with something trendy! Dress up in style with the latest fashion and stand out when you watch anime or play skyblock with friends!

- 8 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Witch Hunters
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Scary monsters constantly terrify villagers and players. Someone has to fight them back and for this, you need brave heroes. Not just ordinary heroes, but real witch hunters! Become a hunter and join the game.

+ Halloween
+ Scary
+ Monsters
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: ADVANCED DINOSAURS
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Dinosaurs are back with an animated twist! Help Dr. Saur build out a dinosaur park by building enclosures, decorating the park, and capturing 20 colorful, prehistoric dinos in ADVANCED DINOSAURS!

+ Decorate your park with animated blocks
+ Unlock vehicles
+ Custom music!
+ Skins!

items.title: Noob vs Pro vs Hacker Mansions
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Three different skill levels and three different luxury mansions! Show off your skills: will you stay a noob or can you work your way up the ladder? Have you got what it takes to live like a pro?

- Mansion survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Casual Streetwear
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Are you missing some stylish looking clothing? Get this skinpack to impress your friends and get into the Fashionworld. 
There is a lot of variety for boys and girls! 

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Nippon Ninjas
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Be dangerous and good looking at the same time. Be a traditional japanese spy and assassin. Explore well designed characters and teach your friends how a ninja dominates this game! 

- 12 skins
- by RareLoot

items.title: Millionaire Underground Base
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Go on and take your survival underground with this pre-built secret underground base, containing redstone farms, automatic furnaces, storage rooms, and a lot more to explore!

- Survival underground base
- Modern house included
- By RareLoot

items.title: Space Rocket
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Take part in an adventure in an abandoned rocket in the middle of space, you are the only survivor of a crew contaminated by a mysterious virus.

- A custom ressource pack
- 4 exclusive skins
- A book of objectives
- Try to survive in a cold and inhuman place
- Take on a new challenge
- By Pixelusion

items.title: Kings Castle
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Want to rule a kingdom full of castles and warriors?
Then move into this majestic king's castle!

items.title: Secret Iceberg Base
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Adrift in the vast ocean on top of an iceberg, adventure waits for a savvy scientist like you! Uncover the secrets of this research station and continue the experiments and research yourself!

- Iceberg base
- By RareLoot

items.title: Secret Villain Base
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Have you found the villain in his secret base?

- Includes a modern mansion plus a secret underground base
- 2 skins included!
- By Eternal Creations

items.title: Icy Teens 2021
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
It's getting cold outside. Take your sled, put on your cool looking clothes that keep you warm for the snow and enjoy playing together with your friends. Epic adventures are waiting!

-12 skins
-By RareLoot

items.title: Castle in the Sky
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Can you climb the magical beanstalk and explore the big castle in the sky? But watch out! Legends say there lives a mysterious creature with a great treasure. 

- Includes the climbable beanstalk with the castle in the sky
- Full interior design with loot
- 1 Skin
- By Eternal Creations

items.title: Best Friends
items.creator: JFCrafters
items.description:
Best friends got each other's back! Get your squad and join the battle. Fight for the victory, explore the unknown and win the prize. Choose the best outfits that suits you: cute, rebellious, glamorous, or even scary and start. Let the world know that you and your teammates are the best!
- 12 cool outfits
- 1 free skin
- Created by Dragon Blocks and published by JFCrafters

items.title: Mob Party
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to party! Put on your best hat and your most awesome clothes with the Mob Party skin pack! Don't turn up looking like a square, turn up looking like the coolest mob in the mines!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Rainbow Mobs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Combine a rainbow with the retro look everyone is trying to recreate with the Cute Retro Rainbow Mobs! Stand out amongst the crowd and shine your own way!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Princess Castle
items.creator: Enchanted
items.description:
Become your favorite princess with Princess Castle! Explore the great hall or visit the aquarium, planetarium, dining hall, stables and more with friends. Adventure across your own lands to uncover treasures and craft your kingdom!
- 2 free skins
- By Enchanted

These awesome high school city teens are great role-playing musicians!

items.title: Descendants of Mobs
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Mobs are back in town! This time you don't have to be afraid of them anymore. You are one of them! Explore the modern city and join the other players on an adventure full of excitement. Get ready because the monsters are coming after you!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!
